نغترف (form VIII)
# نَغْتَرِفُ (naḡtarifu) /naɣ.ta.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# نُغْتَرَفُ (nuḡtarafu) /nuɣ.ta.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# نَغْتَرِفَ (naḡtarifa) /naɣ.ta.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# نُغْتَرَفَ (nuḡtarafa) /nuɣ.ta.ra.fa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
